main_text.l: DE MEDICAMENTIS PVRGANTIBVS SOLIDIS, SIVE IN FORMA PILVLARI.
Clementiora: Azaireth; De hiera S. (à capite); Elephanginae, à stomacho; Imperiales; De agarico, à pectore; Stomachicae, à stomacho.
De hiera cum agarico (à capite); Cochiae; Indae; Arthetica, à iunctguris; Foetidae, à capite; Lucis, ab oculis; De hermod. à iuncturis; De euphorbio.
De rhabarbaro, ab hepate; Sine quib. à capite etiā pituitā educūt; Communes, siue pestilentiales.
Aggregatiuae, à toto; Aureae, à capite, ut etiam Arabicae; Azaircth; De aloe.

page.notes: The diagram is transcribed as a tree; the braces and the marginal fragments of the facing page are only described here. Several words in the diagram are doubtful, notably "iunctguris" (read as iuncturis), "Azaireth/Azaircth" and "Arthetica", and the "à capite" and "à stomacho" labels, which sit beside braces. The catchword-like line "gantubus solidis, siue in forma pilulari" is the continuation of the heading and is included in it.
